title: Rabbi Avin son of Rabbi Tanchum bar Tarfon
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in the Jerusalem Talmud, Bikkurim, beginning of chapter 2.[^1]

notes.text: The stored Guggenheimer digital edition of Jerusalem Talmud Bikkurim 2:1 explicitly names Rabbi Avin son of Rabbi Tanchum bar Trifon (טריפון). This supports the two Rabbi titles and the Jerusalem Talmud identification for the supplied beginning-of-chapter-2 notice. Hyman's supplied heading spells טרפון (Tarfon), retained without adding a title to Tarfon or harmonizing it to Trifon.
